name: pulse-existing-audit
description: Audits existing React components, hooks, utilities, tests, pages, styles, and conventions before Laravel Inertia component work. Use before creating new components, extracting hooks, adding variants, or changing shared UI.
purpose: Prevent duplicate components, inconsistent APIs, and design drift by checking local code and conventions first.
single_responsibility: Survey existing local code and conventions (components, hooks, helpers, pages, styles, tests) relevant to the task before any new code is written.
triggers: About to write new code, to find reusable patterns first
completion_criteria: Relevant components, hooks, helpers, pages, styles, and tests are searched
Sibling file conventions (imports, naming, class merge, test utilities, browser-only guards) are captured
Proposed new code location is informed by existing structure
validation_criteria: New code location is informed by existing structure
failure_handling: If local search cannot confirm whether similar code already exists, stop and report the uncertainty instead of assuming greenfield.
Report any area, directory, or convention that could not be searched or inspected.
escalation_path: Route unclear existing API behaviour to pulse-api-contract.
Route uncertain library or version behaviour to pulse-docs-research.
Surface conflicts between local code and docs to the user when a convention must change.
responsibilities: Search existing components, sections, pages, hooks, libraries, styles, and tests.
Identify reusable primitives and local design patterns.
Identify installed supporting skills and docs that already govern the touched domain.
